title: Randomized recursive NAND tree
statement: For each nonnegative integer $d$, define a randomized decision tree on $2^d$ sign coordinates that computes the depth-$d$ recursive NAND function exactly. Its seed space is the recursively defined depth-$d$ NAND seed space, equipped with its specified probability distribution, and each seed selects the corresponding deterministic recursive NAND tree.
hypotheses_covered: The seed space is the recursive NAND seed space at that depth
A probability mass function is specified on the seed space
Each seed selects a deterministic tree on $2^d$ sign coordinates
Every selected tree computes the depth-$d$ recursive NAND function exactly
caveat: The formal statement refers to the seed distribution and correctness result without including their definitions.
